---
title: WikiPathways
description: WikiPathways' monthly GMT export, every species, as pathway and gene-pathway tables keyed by Entrez GeneID.
---

[WikiPathways](https://www.wikipathways.org) is a community-curated pathway
database. It publishes its pathways as gene sets once a month: one GMT file
per species, the release date in every file name. The release lands every
species file whole, one row per line, and derives
`annotation.wikipathways__pathway` (one row per pathway) and
`annotation.wikipathways__gene_pathway` (one row per pathway and Entrez
gene). The date in the file names is the version.

## Licence and citation

CC0 1.0. Cite WikiPathways as
[its site asks](https://www.wikipathways.org/about.html), with the release date.

## Join keys

- `pathway_id` (`WP554`) joins the two tables; `taxon_id` names the species.
- `gene_id` is the Entrez GeneID, the GMT export's only id system, and joins `annotation.ncbi__gene.gene_id`.

## Good to know

- Pathway ontology tags, authors, last-modified dates and the non-gene nodes (metabolites, interactions) are not in the GMT; they live in the GPML export, which is not landed.
- Raw keeps each line's gene ids as the verbatim tab-joined string, duplicates and order included.
